# IPTV Latino

> IPTV Latino is a subscription-based IPTV service built around Spanish-language and Latin American content — live fútbol from major Latin American and Spanish leagues, novelas, Spanish-language news and entertainment — sitting alongside the same full English-language and international catalog every plan includes. Nothing is removed to make room for the other; both are fully included. Plans include 40,000+ live channels and 180,000+ VOD titles, identical across every plan length — a longer term lowers the price, it never unlocks extra content. Subscriptions run 1, 3, 6, or 12 months, with a $1.00 24-hour trial available before committing. Compatible with Smart TVs, Android TV, Fire TV, Android and iOS devices, Apple TV, Windows, and macOS, using any player app that supports M3U playlists or Xtream Codes-style logins.
